_about: VIS3 item 10: macro ground variation as large soft decal patches (earth, bone dust, cedar needles, ash, moss) per zone. The terrain is ONE shared mesh set and ONE material (M_WorldTerrain), so a per-zone ground material cannot be a material swap; these patches are the data-only substitute. Read by StaticDecals.cs. enabled=false.
_v4_note: laneV4V6 V4 T1: per-zone tint entries tex@zone, rows retargeted, colour only (depthM/liftM untouched). --off restores the backup.
_gid_note: laneGROUNDID gen_groundid.py: gid_/gidI_ rows + textures appended; --off removes them by id prefix.
